📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-02
1. John Ternus Officially Becomes Apple's New CEO產業
John Ternus正式接任蘋果執行長
Apple completed its leadership transition on Tuesday, with hardware engineering chief John Ternus succeeding Tim Cook as CEO after 15 years, while Cook moves to executive chairman. Apple shares rose 2.61% to close at $325.13.
蘋果本周二正式完成執行長交接，硬體工程資深副總裁John Ternus接替掌舵15年的Tim Cook成為新任執行長，Cook轉任執行董事長，當天股價上漲2.61%。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.1, Up to 45% Cheaper for Agentic Work模型
Anthropic推出Claude Fable 5.1，代理型工作成本最高省45%
Anthropic says its newest models, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, address customer complaints about price, data retention, and overzealous safeguards, offering stronger performance at roughly 25% lower typical cost.
Anthropic表示新款模型Fable 5.1與Mythos 5.1回應了客戶對價格、資料保留與過度防護機制的批評，效能優於前代且成本平均降低約25%，代理型工作最高省45%。
The Verge · 原文連結
3. OpenAI Delays Astra Model Development After Hugging Face Hack資安
OpenAI因Hugging Face遭駭延後Astra模型開發
After an unreleased OpenAI model caused an international incident, the company delayed development of its Astra model suite to strengthen safety work; Astra is set to be OpenAI's first model with critical cybersecurity capabilities.
一款未發布的OpenAI模型引發國際關注的資安事件後，OpenAI延後了新模型系列Astra的開發以強化安全工作；Astra將是OpenAI首款具備「重大」網路安全能力的模型。
The Verge · 原文連結
4. Meta Unveils Real-Time Audio Model Muse Voice Transcribe產品
Meta推出即時音訊模型Muse Voice Transcribe
Meta's Superintelligence Labs released its first real-time audio-aware model, combining streaming speech recognition, speaker diarization, and endpoint detection, letting Mac users transcribe speech system-wide by holding the Fn key.
Meta超級智慧實驗室推出首款即時音訊感知模型，整合串流語音辨識、說話者分離與端點偵測，Mac使用者按住Fn鍵即可進行系統級語音輸入。
iThome · 原文連結
5. PaperCut Issues Third Emergency Patch for Actively Exploited Zero-Days資安
PaperCut三度發布緊急修補因應零時差漏洞攻擊
Print management vendor PaperCut released two emergency patches within two days for zero-day flaws CVE-2026-82078 and CVE-2026-81578 in PaperCut NG/MF, as CISA confirms active exploitation in the wild.
列印管理系統供應商PaperCut在兩天內針對PaperCut NG/MF的零時差漏洞CVE-2026-82078與CVE-2026-81578三度發布緊急修補程式，美國CISA證實漏洞遭積極利用。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Microsoft 365 Authentication Issues Disrupt Exchange Online, Teams, and More產業
Microsoft 365驗證異常擴大，Exchange Online、Teams等多項服務受影響
Microsoft began investigating an Exchange Online anomaly early Tuesday Taiwan time, tracing it to core authentication configuration issues that also disrupted Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Purview, and Defender XDR.
微軟於臺灣時間9月1日凌晨調查Exchange Online異常，問題指向處理身分驗證的核心設定，並波及Teams、OneDrive for Business、SharePoint Online、Purview及Defender XDR等服務。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Aurora Ransomware Gang Uses Cursor AI and Claude Sonnet to Target ESXi Systems資安
勒索軟體Aurora借助Cursor AI與Claude Sonnet鎖定ESXi環境
Security firm CloudSEK found Aurora ransomware operators using the Cursor AI coding assistant to plan attacks in Russian while excluding CIS countries; another firm found the group also leveraging Claude Sonnet, with over 20 victim organizations since April.
資安公司CloudSEK發現勒索軟體Aurora的攻擊者使用AI程式碼助手Cursor以俄語規畫攻擊並排除獨立國協地區，另一家資安公司則發現駭客也借助Claude Sonnet，自4月以來已有超過20家企業受害。
iThome · 原文連結
8. Debian Won't Ban AI-Generated Code From Its Linux Distribution政策
Debian不禁止AI程式碼進入其Linux發行版
Debian developers voted to allow AI tools in contributions to development, maintenance, and documentation, stating that "responsible" use of generative AI is neither exempt from nor inherently disqualified by project policy.
Debian開發者投票通過允許在開發、維護與文件貢獻中使用AI工具，新政策指出「負責任」使用生成式AI不會被豁免規範，但也不會被一律禁止。
The Verge · 原文連結
9. Google Pics Is Like Canva, But You Prompt Instead of Design產品
Google Pics如同Canva，但用提示詞取代手動設計
Google's new AI-first creative suite for Workspace, built around Gemini and the Nano Banana image model, aims to make generating and editing "professional-grade" images less cumbersome for businesses.
Google推出以Gemini與Nano Banana生成式AI模型為核心的Workspace創意設計工具Google Pics，主打以提示詞取代傳統設計流程，讓企業更輕鬆產出專業級圖像。
The Verge · 原文連結
10. ChatGPT and Reddit Now Face the EU's Toughest Online Safety Rules政策
ChatGPT與Reddit納入歐盟最嚴格網路安全規範
Explosive user growth has pushed ChatGPT and Reddit into the European Union's strictest platform oversight category, bringing a new wave of regulatory obligations under the Digital Services Act framework.
隨著使用者數量爆炸性成長，ChatGPT與Reddit被納入歐盟數位服務法下最嚴格的平臺監管類別，須承擔更沉重的合規義務。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
